Use gsm.datasim as gsm.core's local test data builder

Source: R/use_gsm_datasim.R
use_gsm_datasim.Rd

Add options(gsm.testdata_builder = "gsm.datasim::build_testdata_bundle") to your user or project .Rprofile. When installed gsm packages don't match a published test data build and at least one is local (e.g. loaded with devtools::load_all()), gsm.core calls this builder to build test data from your local code, caches it, and reuses it in later sessions. If the .Rprofile already sets gsm.testdata_builder (to any value), it is left unchanged.

Usage

use_gsm_datasim(scope = c("user", "project"))

Arguments

scope

Which .Rprofile to edit: "user" (~/.Rprofile, the default) or "project" (.Rprofile in the working directory).

Value

The path to the .Rprofile, invisibly.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
use_gsm_datasim()
use_gsm_datasim("project")
} # }
